SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT DISTINCT BUYER, PO_NO FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_PO_SEND A WHERE 1 = 1 AND BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID = 'IJST') AND IF_FLAG = 'T' ORDER BY BUYER, PO_NO
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT A.BUYER, A.PO_NO, MAX(A.STATUS) AS STATUS, MAX(A.ADD_DATE) AS ADD_DATE, MAX(A.ADD_TIME) AS ADD_TIME, MAX(A.PO_CREATE_DATE) AS PO_CREATE_DATE, MAX(A.KEY_3) AS AGENT, MAX(A.KEY_4) AS CUR, (SELECT SUM(ITEM_AMT) FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_PO_SEND WHERE BUYER = A.BUYER AND PO_NO = A.PO_NO AND STATUS != 'D') AS PO_TTL_AMT, MAX(A.PURCHASER_ID) AS PURCHASER_ID, MAX(A.PURCHASER_NAME) AS PURCHASER_NAME, MAX(A.ACCOUNT_TYPE) AS ACCOUNT_TYPE, MAX(A.HD_REMARK) AS PO_REMARK, MAX(A.ADD_USER_ID) AS ADD_USER_ID, MAX(A.KEY_2) AS DOC_TYPE, MAX(A.KEY_1) AS PO_SUBJECT, MAX(A.DELY_TO_LOCATION) AS DELY_TO_LOCATION, MAX(A.PLANT) AS PLANT FROM EAI.IF_UCUBE_PO_SEND A WHERE A.BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND A.PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND A.IF_FLAG = 'T' GROUP BY A.BUYER, A.PO_NO
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_PO_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATE = SYSDATE, IF_MSG = 'SUCCESS' WHERE 1 = 1 AND BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND IF_FLAG = 'T'
UPDATE EAI.IF_UCUBE_PO_SEND SET IF_FLAG = 'E', IF_DATE = SYSDATE, IF_MSG = 'POHD SEND ERROR' WHERE 1 = 1 AND BUYER = '$G_RS.BUYER$' AND PO_NO = '$G_RS.PO_NO$' AND IF_FLAG = 'T'
